title: Anthropic早期支持者迎来回报窗口
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So Anthropics Upcoming IPO is set to bring multi-billion dollar gains to its investors.
segments.zh: Anthropic即将进行的IPO将为其市场参与者带来数十亿美元的收益。

segments.en: Iconic, an investment firm that owns a stake worth about $17 billion in the company could see the biggest returns.
segments.zh: Iconic是一家持有该公司约170亿美元股份的资管公司，可能获得最大回报。

segments.en: This is one of the most red on Bloomberg today, and it's no surprise.
segments.zh: 这是今天彭博社最热门的新闻之一，并不意外。

segments.en: Bloomberg's venture capital reporter, Natasha Mascaranis, is with us.
segments.zh: 彭博社风险资本记者Natasha Mascaranis与我们同在。

segments.en: Like there are lots of big names in Anthropic.
segments.zh: Anthropic有很多大牌市场参与者。

segments.en: Some of them have been there for a long time, some of them haven't, but you've just set out this wonderful piece.
segments.zh: 有些已经在那里很久了，有些则不是，但你刚刚发表了这篇精彩的文章。

segments.en: Who's going to win? Who's going to gain? I mean, this is definitely a story of the biggest investments leading to the biggest returns, which venture capitalists want to happen.
segments.zh: 谁将获胜？谁将获益？这绝对是最大**带来最大回报的故事，这正是风险资本家所希望的。

segments.en: Concentration is a word we hear a lot about this year, and in this case, many of the firms in our stories.
segments.zh: 集中度是今年我们经常听到的一个词，在我们的故事中，许多公司也是如此。

segments.en: So Iconic, Sequoia, GIC, they made their largest investments of all time in this company, expecting and hoping for it to be their largest returns.
segments.zh: Iconic、红杉、GIC，他们对这家公司进行了有史以来最大的**，期待并希望这能带来最大的回报。

segments.en: But listen, we have to give credit to the early stage firms, Anthropic did not get institutionally backed until 2023, when Spark Capital led its round, it wrote its largest investment at
segments.zh: 但是听着，我们必须赞扬早期阶段的公司，Anthropic直到2023年才获得机构支持，当时Spark Capital领投了其一轮融资，这是其最大的一笔**。

segments.en: the time, 75 million, and now we expect that it's stake to be valued at around 7 billion.
segments.zh: 当时是7500万，现在我们预计这笔权益资产估值约70亿。

segments.en: So it's also how much you pay to get those multi-billion returns that matters.
segments.zh: 所以，支付多少成本来获得这些数十亿回报也很重要。

segments.en: We just showed some of the backers of Anthropic, what's interesting is, wow, institutional money for the first time in 2023, wasn't that long ago.
segments.zh: 我们刚刚展示了Anthropic的一些支持者，有趣的是，哇，机构资金在2023年首次出现，那并不太久远。

segments.en: No. That's what we call strategics come in, right, in video, the cloud computing players.
segments.zh: 不。这就是我们所说的战略市场参与者进来，对吧，在视频中，云计算参与者。
